title: Esther’s Brave Choice
traveler_why: Beau asks Heavenly Father for help before doing hard things, just as Esther prayed and fasted before she bravely went to the king.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he asks Heavenly Father for help before doing hard things. In Beau’s world today: Beau had to get a shot at the doctor, and he felt scared. He squeezed Mom’s hand, took a big brave breath, and whispered a little prayer. It still pinched, but Beau did it! Just like Esther prayed and then bravely went to the king, Beau prayed and then did the hard, brave thing.
